description: Test file for the 'join' slash command in Mattermost, testing various scenarios such as joining channels with different permissions, non-existent channels, and channel name formats.

classes.name: JoinProvider
classes.description: Provider class for handling join commands in slash command tests.

methods.name: TestJoinCommandNoChannel
methods.description: Tests joining a non-existent channel, expecting an error message.

methods.name: TestJoinCommandForExistingChannel
methods.description: Tests joining an existing open channel by name, expecting a redirect URL.

methods.name: TestJoinCommandWithTilde
methods.description: Tests joining a channel with a tilde prefix, expecting a redirect URL.

methods.name: TestJoinCommandPermissions
methods.description: Tests permission scenarios for joining public and private channels, with and without proper permissions.
